ValidationRule.description: Completion must follow start, hours cannot exceed wall-clock time, only Done tasks have completion, Minor tasks avoid weekend completion and identical clock times on different days are rejected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Started_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Completed_At__c)), OR( Completed_At__c < Started_At__c, NULLVALUE(Actual_Hours__c, 0) > ROUND((Completed_At__c - Started_At__c) * 24, 2) + 0.5, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Done')), AND(ISPICKVAL(Severity__c, 'Minor'), OR(WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Completed_At__c)) = 1, WEEKDAY(DATEVALUE(Completed_At__c)) = 7)), AND( HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Started_At__c)) = HOUR(TIMEVALUE(Completed_At__c)), MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(Started_At__c)) = MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(Completed_At__c)), SECOND(TIMEVALUE(Started_At__c)) = SECOND(TIMEVALUE(Completed_At__c)), DATEVALUE(Started_At__c) <> DATEVALUE(Completed_At__c) ) ) )
